title: Switch on outcome-zone shading for barrier contracts
contract types: Higher/Lower, Rise/Fall (after entry), Touch/No Touch (touch side)
dependencies: Design: colour-blind-safe green/red tokens; decide shading for path-dependent Touch/No Touch
risks: Low. Must not imply certainty; keep shading subtle so the price line stays legible

title: Live P/L chip on every open contract
contract types: All (Rise/Fall, Higher/Lower, Touch, digits, Multipliers, Turbos, Vanillas; Accumulators already have it)
dependencies: proposal_open_contract profit stream (already consumed); resolve the iOS crash noted at chart-markers.js:445
risks: Medium: live P/L flicker can trigger emotional early sell-backs; show contract value, not a flashing number

title: Tap a contract on the chart to open details or sell
dependencies: New SmartCharts prop (e.g. onContractMarkerTap) and Dart->JS interop
risks: Low. Selling still needs explicit confirmation; no one-tap sell

title: Volatility context chip per synthetic index
contract types: All, on volatility indices first (realised volatility for Crash/Boom, Jump, Step)
dependencies: Per-symbol sigma: published constant for volatility indices (deriv.com/markets/synthetic); not found in the API payloads the trader reads, so a static table or new API field is needed
risks: Low; factual. Must not read as a signal

title: Payout preview at the barrier while dragging
dependencies: Debounced proposal on drag (already re-prices); show 'updating…' while the server answers
risks: Low. Payout is already shown in the Buy button

title: Expose cheap engine extras: Gator, ATR, StdDev and %B indicators; crosshair callbacks
contract types: Chart-analysis users on any contract; ATR/StdDev aid volatility reading on synthetics
dependencies: None
risks: Low

title: Heikin-Ashi chart type
contract types: Candle users (Multipliers, Vanillas, Turbos, longer Rise/Fall)
dependencies: None
risks: Low; HA prices are synthetic, so label the price axis clearly

title: Expiry and purchase-deadline markers with countdown on the time axis
contract types: All time-based contracts; tick contracts get tick rungs ('3/5') on the axis
dependencies: Proposal date_expiry / tick count (available in trade store); server time sync
risks: Low-medium: countdowns add urgency; avoid red flashing in the final seconds

title: First-render and frame-rate performance budget
dependencies: Field telemetry (time-to-first-tick, dropped frames); low-end Android test devices
risks: Low. Confidence is low because the 5-10 s blank canvas was observed only once, logged out, on one network

title: Multipliers: persistent, draggable TP/SL lines with P/L tooltip
contract types: Multipliers (the only type for some EU accounts)
dependencies: contract_update API (already used in core contract-store.js) for modifying TP/SL on open contracts
risks: Medium: easy SL widening can deepen losses; consider a confirm step when SL moves away from price

title: Responsible-trading meter in the trade flow
dependencies: Account limits / self-exclusion data (not called from this repo; confirm API); session P/L from statement
risks: Positive for responsible trading; needs compliance sign-off on wording

title: Sub-minute candles (1 s, 5 s, 15 s, 30 s) built from ticks
contract types: Rise/Fall, Higher/Lower and Touch with second-level durations; Multipliers scalping
dependencies: ticks_history candles start at 60 s (adapter whitelist), so aggregate client-side from ticks; history depth limited by tick history
risks: Low

title: Contract replay playback and 'my recent trades' markers
dependencies: profit_table / statement for past contracts; tick history for the replay window
risks: Low; supports learning. Avoid 'you would have won' framing

title: Trade-from-chart gesture: long-press or price-axis '+' sets the barrier
dependencies: R05 (payout label) for feedback
risks: Medium: accidental trades. Open a prefilled ticket; never buy on the gesture

title: Outlook-first contract picker with mini payoff cards
dependencies: Design and content; per-contract payoff thumbnails are static assets
risks: Low-medium: must stay educational, not a 'best trade' recommender

title: Engine localisation, RTL and local time zone
dependencies: Crowdin/Makima pipeline for engine strings; RTL QA in Arabic
risks: Low

title: Probability chip on barriers (touch / finish-beyond), model estimate
contract types: Higher/Lower, Touch/No Touch, Turbos (knock-out), Multipliers (TP vs SL first)
dependencies: R04 sigma data; quant sign-off on drift, annualisation and discrete-tick correction; compliance approval
risks: High: shows house margin; may read as advice or as a nudge to trade. Gate per jurisdiction and A/B for over-trading

title: Expected-move / probability cone to expiry
contract types: Rise/Fall, Higher/Lower, Touch/No Touch, Vanillas, Turbos on volatility indices
dependencies: R04 sigma, R08 expiry on time axis, R17 maths and approvals
risks: Medium-high: model assumptions do not hold for Crash/Boom, Jump, Step or real markets; keep off by default

title: Live win-probability strip for open contracts
contract types: Binary outcomes (Rise/Fall, Higher/Lower, Touch), Turbos survival, Accumulators survival
dependencies: R17 maths and approvals
risks: High: may encourage panic selling or chasing; test with responsible-trading metrics

title: Payoff panel for Vanillas, Turbos and Multipliers
dependencies: Expiry payoff needs no model; a 'now' curve needs a pricing model (sigma known only for volatility indices)
risks: Low-medium; educational if the max loss (stake) is shown prominently

title: Strike / barrier ladder on the price axis with payout per rung
dependencies: barrier_choices from contracts_for (in trade store); payouts per rung need extra proposals (API load)
risks: Medium: API cost; clutter on small screens
